attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Carolina state income tax. Flat 4.25% rate (NCGS § 105-153.7, 2025; reducing to 3.99% in 2026) on AGI minus filing-status standard deduction. Standard deductions: $12,750 Single/MFS, $25,500 MFJ/QSS, $22,500 HOH. Writes result.nc_taxable_income and result.nc_state_tax.

initial_action.action_comment: Reset NC tax fields and log calculation start
initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.nc_state_tax = 0; set result.nc_taxable_income = 0; set result.nc_total_deduction = 0; add " North Carolina Tax Calculation (Form D-400) - flat 4.25%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.nc_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.nc_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.nc_total_deduction xdef " North Carolina Tax Calculation (Form D-400) — flat 4.25%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.nc_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 25500.0) and 0.0; set result.nc_state_tax = result.nc_taxable_income * 0.0425
action_details.action_postfix: nc_standard_deduction_joint /result.nc_total_deduction xdef result.agi result.nc_total_deduction f- 0.0 fmax /result.nc_taxable_income xdef result.nc_taxable_income nc_tax_rate f* /result.nc_state_tax xdef " NC taxable income (MFJ, $25,500 std ded): $" result.nc_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " NC state tax (flat 4.25%): $" result.nc_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.nc_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 22500.0) and 0.0; set result.nc_state_tax = result.nc_taxable_income * 0.0425
action_details.action_postfix: nc_standard_deduction_hoh /result.nc_total_deduction xdef result.agi result.nc_total_deduction f- 0.0 fmax /result.nc_taxable_income xdef result.nc_taxable_income nc_tax_rate f* /result.nc_state_tax xdef " NC taxable income (HOH, $22,500 std ded): $" result.nc_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " NC state tax (flat 4.25%): $" result.nc_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.nc_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 12750.0) and 0.0; set result.nc_state_tax = result.nc_taxable_income * 0.0425
action_details.action_postfix: nc_standard_deduction_single /result.nc_total_deduction xdef result.agi result.nc_total_deduction f- 0.0 fmax /result.nc_taxable_income xdef result.nc_taxable_income nc_tax_rate f* /result.nc_state_tax xdef " NC taxable income (Single/MFS, $12,750 std ded): $" result.nc_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " NC state tax (flat 4.25%): $" result.nc_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Carolina military retirement pay exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. Full exemption for 20+ years of service or medical retirement; changed from partial to full exemption in 2021. MSRRA / SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.
